title: Contiguous bidirectional Layer swimlanes
description: Render Layer view as contiguous swimlanes with orientation derived from graph direction.
completion_criteria: Layer bands share borders without visible gutters.
LR graphs render horizontal lanes with left-to-right flow.
TD and TB graphs render vertical lanes with top-to-bottom flow.
Syntax and AI authoring guidance explain the orientation contract.
Targeted tests, typecheck, and production build pass.
success_criteria: Business workflows can be expressed as conventional horizontal or vertical swimlanes.
Lane geometry remains deterministic and independent from zone and boundary overlays.
triage_notes: The internal node placement gap remains separate from the rendered lane bands so nodes retain breathing room while lane backgrounds stay contiguous.
